两份抓取要是同一种才能对比：{a} 是 {ka}，{b} 是 {kb}: Only captures of the same kind can be compared: {a} is {ka}, {b} is {kb}
这个版本能抓 csv（CSV Profiler）和 memreport；trac: This version captures csv (CSV Profiler) and memreport; trace and GPU need a bridge update
已经有一个 CSV 抓取在进行（{label}，已经 {s} 秒，id {id}: A CSV capture is already running ({label}, {s} s so far, id {id}): stop it before starting another
Agent 要开始性能抓取: The agent wants to start a performance capture
CSV Profiler（每帧各项耗时），最长 {s} 秒，到时间自动停；文件写: CSV Profiler (per-frame timings), up to {s} s, stops automatically; the file goes to the project's Saved/Profiling/CSV
已经让 UE 停止 CSV 抓取，但 20 秒内没在 Saved/Profili: UE was told to stop the CSV capture, but no new file appeared in Saved/Profiling/CSV within 20 s. This build may not include the CSV Profiler (Shipping builds don't by default), or the file was written elsewhere. UE output: {out}
没有正在进行的抓取，书签要在 start 和 stop 之间打: No capture is running; add bookmarks between start and stop
Agent 要抓一份内存报告: The agent wants to take a memory report
执行 memreport -full：游戏会卡几秒，文件写在项目的 Saved/: Runs memreport -full: the game freezes for a few seconds; the file goes to the project's Saved/Profiling/MemReports
已经执行 memreport -full，但 60 秒内没在 Saved/Pro: memreport -full was run, but no new file appeared in Saved/Profiling/MemReports within 60 s. UE output: {out}
Agent 要取消登记一份导入的抓取: The agent wants to unregister an imported capture
Agent 要删除一份抓取文件: The agent wants to delete a capture file
抓帧数据和内存报告，看摘要、对比，或者交给 Agent 分析: Capture frame data and memory reports, view summaries, compare, or hand them to the agent
UE 没在运行：现在不能抓新的，已经抓到的文件照样能看、能对比、能交给 Agen: UE isn't running: you can't start a new capture, but existing files can still be viewed, compared and handed to the agent.
在要测的操作前后各打一个书签，分析时可以按书签分段: Add a bookmark before and after the action you're measuring to split the analysis by bookmark
还没有抓取。点右上角「抓帧数据」录一段，或者让 Agent 用 ue_perf: No captures yet. Click "Capture frames" at the top right, or let the agent capture with ue_perf
导入的外部文件只取消登记，不删原文件。: Imported external files are only unregistered; the original file is kept.
Unreal Insights 的 trace 这个版本还不能在这里分析，先用: Unreal Insights traces can't be analyzed here in this version; open them in Unreal Insights for now.
平均 {fps} 帧/秒，最差 1% 时 {low} 帧/秒: {fps} fps average, {low} fps at the worst 1%
这份内存报告里没认出按类的对象表，可以让 Agent 按分段看原文。: No per-class object table was recognized in this memory report; the agent can read the raw sections.
对象总数 {n}，对象大小 {kb} KB，持有的资源 {res} KB: Objects {n}, object size {kb} KB, held resources {res} KB
两份报告里各个类的对象数量一样。: Both reports have the same object counts for every class.
强删（引用它的资源会断开）: force delete (assets that reference it will break)
{pkg} 正被另一个对话修改、还没保存。等它保存或放弃改动后再改，不要绕过去: {pkg} is being modified by another conversation and hasn't been saved. Wait until it saves or discards its changes; don't work around this
UE 页「桥接与权限」里没有允许 Agent 做结构性操作（新建、复制、改名），: Structural operations (create, duplicate, rename) are not allowed for agents under Bridge & permissions on the UE page, so this can't run: {what}
Agent 要新建 / 复制 / 改名 UE 资源: The agent wants to create / duplicate / rename a UE asset
UE 页「桥接与权限」里没有允许 Agent 做结构性操作，不能删除：{what: Structural operations are not allowed for agents under Bridge & permissions on the UE page, so this can't be deleted: {what}
Agent 要删除 UE 资源: The agent wants to delete a UE asset
UE 页「桥接与权限」里没有打开「执行 Python」，Agent 不能在编辑器: "Run Python" is off under Bridge & permissions on the UE page, so the agent can't run Python in the editor
Agent 要在 UE 编辑器里执行 Python: The agent wants to run Python in the UE editor
执行的 Python 代码不能自动撤回: Executed Python code can't be undone automatically
新建、复制、改名、删除不能自动撤回：没保存前用「放弃改动」，或反向再做一次: Create, duplicate, rename and delete can't be undone automatically: use Discard changes before saving, or do the reverse operation
编辑器不认识 py 命令：项目没有启用 Python Editor Script: The editor doesn't recognize the py command: the project hasn't enabled the Python Editor Script Plugin (enable it under Edit → Plugins, then restart the editor)
太长，后面的没有显示；切到「节点」分页看: Too long, the rest isn't shown; switch to Nodes to page through it
选一个资源：DataTable 显示成表格，DataAsset 显示属性，蓝图可: Select an asset: DataTables show as a table, DataAssets show properties, and blueprints show an outline and graphs
改 DataTable、DataAsset、蓝图的默认值、成员和图表: Edit DataTables, DataAssets, and blueprint defaults, members and graphs
新建、复制、改名和移动资源；删除每次都问你: Create, duplicate, rename and move assets; deletion always asks you
兜底用：在编辑器里跑任意脚本，没有撤回；开了也每次问你，项目要启用 Python: Fallback: runs arbitrary scripts in the editor with no undo; asks you every time even when on, and the project must enable the Python plugin
按项目连接正在运行的 Unreal Engine（5.4 及以上）：控制台、GM: Connect per project to a running Unreal Engine (5.4+): console, GM, find Actors by name, read and edit runtime properties, DataTables and assets (readable even with the editor closed), logs and screenshots; asset summaries, references, create / duplicate / rename / delete, and reading, editing and compiling blueprint variables, components and graphs; projects with UnLua can also search Lua instances, view and edit Lua fields, and run Lua. Agents can use all of this to debug, tune values and edit blueprints.
